subject.title: fix(ui): keep Codex commentary visible after runs

question: Should an existing explicit `chatPersistCommentary: false` continue to prevent durable commentary retention, or should OpenClaw intentionally redefine it as a display-only setting for all upgraded users?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the meaning of a persisted user preference; tests can verify either behavior but cannot choose the product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve the existing false semantics
options.body: Keep durable commentary creation conditional on the existing preference for upgraded profiles, and add any reversible display behavior through a separately approved setting or migration.

options.title: Adopt display-only semantics
options.body: Approve durable commentary retention even when users previously selected false, with explicit upgrade and privacy documentation plus live proof of the new behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing false semantics
recommendation.body: Keep durable commentary creation conditional on the existing preference for upgraded profiles, and add any reversible display behavior through a separately approved setting or migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The available change history ties this contributor directly to the affected Codex projector and Control UI preference surfaces.
